def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    rs=[i for i,_ in obj]; cs=[j for _,j in obj]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
